section_summary.extract_value: This section presents results from a multiple regression analysis examining how body-related talk (weight loss talk and exercise talk) predicts body appreciation while controlling for BMI. The analysis included 138 participants and found that increased BMI (β = −.32) and weight loss talk (β = −.37) negatively predicted body appreciation, while exercise talk (β = .23) positively predicted it. The overall model accounted for 28% of the variance in body appreciation.
